posts.title: Why I Volunteer as a Blood Biker
posts.description: Most people haven’t heard of blood bikers. The short version: we’re volunteer motorcyclists who transport urgent medical supplies for the NHS out of hours. Blood products, plasma, samples, breast milk, medication. The things that hospitals need moved quickly when the normal courier services aren’t running. I ride for Greater Manchester Blood Bikes.
